{"notes": "Visit 1 (ending 1:00). Only saw 0:15-0:45; don't know who placed which domino. Picture: one dark chain from START (tail, ~28,4.2) running down-left to ~(22.8,7.5), about 11 dominoes, all connected. Nobody's hands labeled, so can't credit placement to anyone yet.

Priya: Chose fish, announced plan, said she was laying the top line, and delegated stroke 2 to Maya and tail help to Tom/Leo. Clear leadership and direction early. The connected chain is probably the top line she said she was laying, but I didn't see who placed it. Watch whether she keeps coordinating or just builds.

Leo: Backed the fish, explained the push logic (start at tail, run round to nose, bottom line comes back, one push topples both). Useful design thinking. Offered to watch the nose joins and fix breaks. Good collaboration and QA so far, but all talk that I saw; need to see him execute.

Tom: Backed the plan, noticed Maya's hands weren't on the bottom line and proactively started it himself, with a polite check-in to Maya and thanks to Leo. Good initiative and collaboration. Note the bottom line isn't visible in the picture yet, so unclear how much got done.

Maya: Assigned the bottom line (stroke 2) by Priya, but she said nothing in my visit and Tom didn't see her hands on it. Possibly idle, stuck, or working elsewhere. Don't judge yet; ask her privately and check next visit. No bottom line progress visible.

Concern: only one line started at 1:00 of 10 minutes; need the bottom line and nose joins moving."}
